rules.description: Case must be in an eligible category for legal aid
rules.reason_if_failed: Your type of legal case is not covered by legal aid. You may be able to apply for exceptional case funding if your human rights are at risk.

rules.description: Joint monthly income must be £2,657 or less (before tax), or receiving qualifying benefits
rules.reason_if_failed: Your household income is above the threshold for legal aid. You may still be eligible if your case involves domestic abuse or forced marriage.

rules.description: Alternative income test: receiving Universal Credit, Pension Credit (Guarantee), JSA, ESA, or Income Support
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not receive a qualifying benefit and your income exceeds the threshold

rules.description: Assets (savings, investments, home equity over £100k) must not exceed £8,000
rules.reason_if_failed: Your savings and assets exceed the £8,000 threshold. You may still be eligible if you are over State Pension age, disputing home ownership, or your case involves domestic abuse or forced marriage.

rules.description: Case must have reasonable prospects of success and be proportionate
rules.reason_if_failed: Your case does not meet the merits test for legal aid funding. Discuss alternative options with your solicitor.

rules.description: Applicant must be represented by a legal aid solicitor
rules.reason_if_failed: You must instruct a legal aid solicitor to apply for legal aid. Find a legal aid solicitor via the LAA directory.

rules.description: Legal aid application must be for a case in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for legal aid in England and Wales only. Contact Legal Aid Scotland or the Northern Ireland Legal Services Agency.

explanation_template: Legal aid eligibility: {outcome}. Means test: {means_result}. Merits test: {merits_result}.

edge_cases.description: Domestic abuse cases have wider financial eligibility (higher income and assets allowed)
edge_cases.action: Apply relaxed means test thresholds. Applicant may still be eligible even if income or assets exceed standard limits.

edge_cases.description: Cases involving mental health tribunals, child abduction, or children in care are automatically eligible regardless of means
edge_cases.action: Skip means test. Proceed directly to merits assessment.

edge_cases.description: Urgent cases (e.g., immediate risk of harm) can receive emergency legal representation before full assessment
edge_cases.action: Grant Emergency Legal Representation. Full legal aid application must still be completed within statutory timeframe.

edge_cases.description: Cases not normally eligible may qualify if human rights are at risk
edge_cases.detection: human_rights_risk == true AND case_category NOT IN eligible_categories
edge_cases.action: Route to Exceptional Case Funding (ECF) process. Requires separate ECF application demonstrating human rights infringement.

edge_cases.description: Under 18s in full-time education automatically get legal aid for criminal defence
edge_cases.detection: age < 18 AND in_full_time_education == true AND case_category == 'criminal-defence'
edge_cases.action: Grant automatic legal aid for criminal defence. No means test required.

edge_cases.description: If applicant wins money or property, LAA may recover costs via statutory charge
edge_cases.action: LAA Secured Debt Team will assess statutory charge. Applicant may need to repay legal aid costs from award.

edge_cases.description: Partner's income and assets are included in means test unless good reason to exclude
edge_cases.action: Include partner's financial details in means test. Applicant must provide partner's consent or show good reason for exclusion (e.g., financial abuse).
